visualReview.notes: Inspected the complete palace from four directions and the closer views of the east arcade, terracotta pavilions, three entrance arches, upper jali, rear wings, stairs and fountain. Recesses, dark stone lower columns, and the upper rail openings are visible at closer levels.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected ten shared-surface and geographic flat-fixture views. Lime stucco, stone, tile and wood-colored window and door details read clearly. The flat fixture hides the sunken fountain. It appears on the original-ground and contextual views. Shared material bindings and unload passed.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 26 current frames, including the four level and transition comparisons. All levels keep the dual arched galleries, stepped roofline and side wings. The district and detailed levels retain open loggias, and the closest levels show the gable oculus, jali, finials and balusters.

geographicReview.notes: The 18-corner standing footprint, mapped east approach and fountain and original 256 m field anchor the palace. The unmasked elevation view shows the reveal of the stone plinth and the fountain on the lower forecourt. Stair treads, threshold height and foundation dimensions are estimated.

fidelityReview.scope: Standing Aga Khan Palace exterior in Pune, from its mapped forecourt steps and fountain through the arcaded palace ranges to the rear wings. Museum interiors, detached buildings and memorials are outside this model’s scope.
fidelityReview.notes: The metro and local architectural reports establish the 2.5 m verandas, Italianate arches, triple entrance, dark stone below stucco, continuous balustrades and hipped tiled roof pavilions. Bay counts outside the entrance, gable dimensions, heights and rear volumes are approximate. Small ornament uses simplified original geometry.

imageryReview.notes: Started with the Qualla media inventory. The exact public-domain photograph depicts the nearby memorial, which falls outside the palace footprint. The historical palace photograph has unresolved provenance for first publication and US status. The model uses mapped geometry, unaltered terrain and the written architectural survey.

primaryFactsReview.notes: The native standing building, east approach and fountain are preserved. Architectural reports establish the arcade depth, triple porch, roof and material profiles. Estimated heights and openings are recorded in the model.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: Standing Aga Khan Palace in Pune, including the main loggias, east approach fountain and roofed rear ranges.

limitations: The model covers the present mapped palace exterior, deep arcades, entrance hall, receding upper floor, hipped tiled pavilions and east forecourt fountain. Heights, bay counts outside the three documented porch arches, range roof outlines and rear details are estimates.

The unaltered elevation field fixes the east stair and footprint grade. The stone plinth and stair lengths are approximated within that slope. The ground map and published gross floor areas describe different measurement boundaries.

Carved jali, badges, balusters and finials use simplified original geometry. Written architectural records and the named outline establish the exterior; the historical photograph’s current record leaves its release unresolved.
